resource_sites.name: Drowned Copse
resource_sites.description: Cut driftwood beneath the drowned canopy. Wings stir overhead.
resource_sites.route: Tower gate → floor 3 camp → Drowned Copse

resource_sites.description: Break iron from the wet earth. Arcane creatures guard the exposed seams.
resource_sites.route: Tower gate → floor 3 camp → Bog-Iron Field

resource_sites.name: Tempered Scrap Seam
resource_sites.description: Prise tempered steel from buried machinery. Magic-bound remnants guard the seam.

resource_sites.name: Buried Heartwood Grove
resource_sites.description: Cut dense roots beside the processional forest. Moths and wisps circle the old canopy.
resource_sites.route: Tower gate → floor 25 camp → Buried Heartwood Grove

resource_sites.name: Starforge Slag Beds
resource_sites.description: Sift hot steel from cooled slag. Rune-marked salamanders stalk the beds.
resource_sites.route: Tower gate → floor 45 camp → Starforge Slag Beds

resource_sites.name: Fallen-Star Crater
resource_sites.description: Split starstone on the crater rim. Ravens and quarry hunters shelter in the broken rock.
resource_sites.route: Tower gate → floor 55 camp → Fallen-Star Crater

resource_sites.name: Shard Fissure
resource_sites.description: Lift shards from a singing fracture. Bound gales and pressure ghosts gather at its mouth.
resource_sites.route: Tower gate → floor 70 camp → Shard Fissure

resource_sites.name: Mythic Loom Hollow
resource_sites.description: Take threads from abandoned sky-nests. Pale scavengers keep watch above the hollow.
resource_sites.route: Tower gate → floor 80 camp → Mythic Loom Hollow
